unit.why: A single narrative: the Besht, instructed from Heaven, takes his disciples to a village to learn trust in God from an old Jewish lessee who must pay the lord's rent.

stories.start_quote: מעשה שצו׳ ל הבעש״ט מן השמים
stories.summary_en: Heaven sends the Besht and his disciples to a village. Their host, an old Jewish toll-lessee, has no money for the lord's rent but calmly trusts in God, eats a long meal, and on his way to the lord is paid by a passing traveller for spirits he had sold him. The Besht draws the lesson of the power of trust.
